about.title: About TeaVibe
about.intro: At TeaVibe, we believe that every cup of tea tells a story. Founded with a passion for exceptional quality and sustainable sourcing, we bring the world's finest teas directly to your doorstep.
about.qualityDesc: Every tea we offer is carefully selected from renowned gardens and independently tested for purity and taste.
about.passionDesc: Our team of certified tea sommeliers taste hundreds of teas each year to curate only the very best for you.
about.sustainableDesc: We partner with ethical farms that practice sustainable agriculture, ensuring both quality and environmental responsibility.
about.storyText:
TeaVibe was born from a simple belief: everyone deserves access to extraordinary tea. What started as a small passion project grew into a curated marketplace connecting tea lovers with master growers across China, Japan, India, Sri Lanka, and beyond.

We work directly with family-owned gardens and cooperatives, cutting out middlemen to ensure farmers are fairly compensated and you receive the freshest, most authentic teas possible. Each of our teas comes with full traceability — you can know exactly where your leaves were grown, when they were harvested, and how they were processed.

Today, TeaVibe serves thousands of tea enthusiasts in Cyprus and across Europe, delivering premium loose-leaf teas, accessories, and seasonal collections with the care and attention they deserve.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: We love hearing from our customers. Whether you have a question about your order, need help choosing a tea, or just want to share your experience — we are here for you.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our teas, ordering, and shipping.
faq.q1: What types of tea do you offer?
faq.a1: We offer a wide range of premium loose-leaf teas including green, black, white, oolong, pu-erh, and herbal blends. All teas are sourced directly from certified gardens and estates worldwide.
faq.q2: How should I store my tea?
faq.a2: Store your tea in an airtight container, away from direct sunlight, moisture, and strong odours. A cool, dark cupboard works perfectly. Most teas will stay fresh for 12–24 months when stored correctly.
faq.a3: Yes, we ship to most European countries and selected international destinations. Shipping rates and delivery times vary by destination. Please see our Shipping Information page for full details.
faq.q4: How long will my order take to arrive?
faq.a4: Orders within Cyprus typically arrive within 2–3 business days. EU orders take 5–10 business days. International orders may take 10–21 business days depending on the destination.
faq.q5: Can I return or exchange my tea?
faq.a5: Due to the perishable nature of food products, we are unable to accept returns on opened teas. However, if your order arrives damaged or incorrect, please contact us within 14 days and we will make it right.
faq.q6: Do you offer gift wrapping or gift cards?
faq.a6: Yes! We offer beautiful gift wrapping for a small additional charge, and digital gift cards are available in various denominations. Select these options during checkout.
faq.ctaText: Our tea experts are happy to help. Reach out to us directly and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

shipping.title: Shipping Information
shipping.s1Text: We offer free standard delivery on all orders over €40 within Cyprus. Orders under €40 are charged a flat shipping fee of €4.50. Standard delivery takes 2–3 business days from the date of dispatch. Express next-day delivery is available for orders placed before 12:00 noon for an additional €7.00.
shipping.s2Text: We ship to all EU member states and selected international destinations. Shipping rates are calculated at checkout based on weight and destination. EU orders typically arrive within 5–10 business days. Non-EU international orders may take 10–21 business days. Please note that customs duties or import taxes for non-EU destinations are the responsibility of the recipient.
shipping.s3Text: Once your order is dispatched, you will receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. You can use this number to track your parcel on the courier's website. If you have not received your tracking details within 24 hours of dispatch, please check your spam folder or contact our support team.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.s1Text: We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. Due to food safety regulations, we are unable to accept returns on opened or used tea products. However, if your item arrives damaged, defective, or if you received the wrong product, we will happily arrange a replacement or full refund. Please contact us within 14 days of receiving your order.
returns.s2Text: To initiate a return, please email us at hello@teavibe.store with your order number, a description of the issue, and photos if applicable. Our team will review your request within 1–2 business days and provide return instructions. Items must be returned in their original, unopened packaging. Return shipping costs are covered by TeaVibe for defective or incorrect items.
returns.s3Text: Once we receive and inspect your return, we will process your refund within 5–7 business days. Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Please allow an additional 3–5 business days for the funds to appear in your account, depending on your bank or payment provider. We do not charge any restocking fees.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Text: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, shipping address, and payment details when you create an account or place an order. We also automatically collect certain technical data including your IP address, browser type, and browsing behaviour on our site through cookies and similar technologies.
privacy.s2Text: We use your personal information to process orders, send transactional emails (order confirmations, shipping updates), provide customer support, and improve our services. With your consent, we may also send you promotional communications about new products and offers. We never sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.s3Text: We use essential cookies to keep your shopping cart active and maintain your session. We also use analytics cookies (Google Analytics) to understand how visitors use our site. You can manage your cookie preferences at any time through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect the functionality of the website.
privacy.s4Text: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. You may also request data portability or object to certain types of processing. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at hello@teavibe.store. We will respond to all requests within 30 days in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
